name: @uptimebuyer/worker
description: Bounded non-payment worker process (M14): schedules every outbox, job, sweep and platform runner with bounded jittered intervals, a PostgreSQL advisory lock per runner (two replicas never run the same runner at once), graceful shutdown bound to a root AbortSignal, health/readiness and closed-label metrics. Never imports the Kite broker and never holds Kite credentials or paid egress.
